jobs.title: IT/AV Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** IT/AV Project Coordinator


**Department:** IT/AV Services

**IT/AV Project Coordinator \- Job Summary**


The IT/AV Project Coordinator will act as a key liaison for coordinating and executing technology projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. This role involves tracking orders, facilitating planning meetings, coordinating with clients, overseeing the work of internal teams and third‑party vendors, and preparing final project documentation.


Candidates must possess strong organizational, multitasking, and customer‑service skills. A strong background in IT and AV technologies is highly preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate, define, staff, and manage one or multiple IT/AV projects from start to finish.
* Serve as the primary project point of contact for management, technical teams, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct site surveys and participate in project kickoff meetings.
* Develop detailed project schedules, lead project status meetings, and manage resource allocation.
* Work closely with project owners to monitor delivery performance, ensure quality standards, and manage timelines and budgets.
* Create and deliver accurate pre‑project and post‑project documentation.
* Oversee project execution, including building project plans, assigning resources, tracking progress, and ensuring timely completion.
* Collect and document business requirements and workflows from users.
* Perform quality assurance checks and prepare related documentation.
* Plan, coordinate, and deliver user training as needed.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum of five (5\) years' experience as a Project Manager, Account Manager, Project Specialist, or similar role managing enterprise‑level projects.
* PMP certification preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in client engagement.
* Previous experience working on IT and AV technical projects.
* Strong writing, documentation, and reporting abilities.
* Proven analytical and problem‑solving skills.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for six consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid\-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, healthcare, and educational institutions nationwide.


Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry\-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. Through strategic partnerships with top manufacturers and visionary technology providers, GST empowers organizations to achieve their business objectives with confidence and efficiency.

**Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in IT/AV solutions!**

**For more information, please visit www.gstinc.com**

**Position Title:** Contracts \& Program Coordinator \- NASA SEWP

**Position Overview**


Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Contracts \& Program Coordinator** to support and manage daily operations of our **NASA SEWP VI** contract vehicle.


This role is responsible for reviewing customer RFQs and bids, obtaining vendor pricing, and developing accurate quotes, proposals, and contract submissions for federal government customers.


The ideal candidate has experience in federal contracting, government procurement, proposal development, and inside or outside sales. Success in this role requires the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and deliver timely, compliant, and competitive responses in a fast\-paced technology and public sector sales environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day activities supporting GST's NASA SEWP contract vehicle.
* Review customer RFQs, RFPs, and bid requests to ensure accurate, complete, and timely responses.
* Obtain and evaluate pricing, product availability, and lead times from OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Build, price, and submit accurate quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for federal government customers.
* Support the full quote\-to\-order process, including opportunity qualification, quote development, proposal submission, and order handoff.
* Ensure compliance with NASA SEWP contract requirements, federal procurement guidelines, and company policies.
* Partner with Federal Account Executives to support sales opportunities, customer requests, and business growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with procurement, engineering, contracts, finance, and sales teams to develop competitive and compliant solutions.
* Track quote activity, sales pipeline metrics, contract utilization, and proposal status.
* Maintain contract records, customer documentation, and reporting within CRM, ERP, CPQ, and quote management systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of proven inside or outside sales experience, including direct customer engagement, quote generation, proposal development, and sales cycle management.
* Experience supporting federal government contracts, procurement, or acquisition programs.
* Experience preparing and managing quotes, proposals, bids, and RFQ responses.
* Strong understanding of government purchasing processes and contract compliance requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer service communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, procurement, contracts, finance, and vendor teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building, pricing, and submitting complex quotes and proposals for federal government customers.
* Experience supporting NASA Solutions for Enterprise\-Wide Procurement **(SEWP)**, General Services Administration **(GSA)** Schedules, Government\-Wide Acquisition Contracts **(GWACs),** Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity **(IDIQ)** contracts, or similar federal contract vehicles.
* Knowledge of the **Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)** and government procurement practices.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor pricing programs.
* Experience with **NetSuite, Salesforce,** or other **ERP, CRM, or quote management platforms**.
* Experience in the IT, technology, government contracting, or VAR industry.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for seven consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid\-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions nationwide.


Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry\-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. Through strategic partnerships with top manufacturers and visionary technology providers, GST empowers organizations to achieve their business objectives with confidence and efficiency.

jobs.title: Account Management & Renewals Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Account Management \& Renewals Coordinator (Travel/Remote)** **Sullivan on Comp** is a subscription\-based legal research and technology platform serving the California workers’ compensation industry. The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Account Management \& Renewals Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for renewals, account management, customer retention, and account growth.  

The primary focus of this role is to ensure that renewals, customer requests, account changes, documentation, and follow\-up activities are handled accurately and on time, while promptly identifying matters that require Account Executive involvement. **Compensation:**  

* $29 – $35/hour ($60,320 – $72,800 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
* This position is classified as non\-exempt and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.
 **Travel \& Work Location**  

* Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
* Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.

 **Daily Objectives:**  

* Manage the end\-to\-end renewal process, including tracking upcoming renewals, coordinating customer communications, processing standard renewal requests, and maintaining accurate renewal status in HubSpot.
* Monitor customer accounts and proactively identify renewals, retention risks, account changes, or nonstandard situations requiring Account Executive involvement.
* Maintain accurate group\-account, subscription, billing, user, and account information while coordinating routine account updates with internal teams.
* Support customer retention and growth initiatives by identifying potential upgrade, expansion, and Cadence opportunities and escalating them to the Account Executive.
* Prepare quotes, contracts, renewal documents, account reviews, and related documentation while tracking outstanding forms, requests, and customer commitments through completion.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, customer interactions, renewal activities, forecasts, reports, and account\-status tracking to support informed decision\-making.
* Conduct routine customer follow\-up, respond to standard account and renewal inquiries, and help maintain engagement between strategic account conversations.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of customer requests and a positive client experience.
* Provide actionable account intelligence by identifying upcoming renewals, accounts requiring attention, retention opportunities, and customer trends that support account management strategy.
* Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through event preparation, on\-site participation, customer engagement, lead follow\-up, and business travel as needed.
 **Skills \& Experience:**  

* 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
* Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.

 **Health \& Wellness**  

* Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO

 **Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.

jobs.title: Community Marketing Coordinator- Fatburger
jobs.description:
Description:

FAT Brands Inc is a leading global franchising company that develops and grows fast casual, quick\-service, and casual dining concepts around the world — a portfolio of 11 brands, including Round Table Pizza®, Fatburger, Marble Slab Creamery, Johnny Rockets, Fazoli’s, Great American Cookies, Buffalo’s Cafe \& Express, Hurricane Grill \& Wings, Native Grill \& Wings, Pretzelmaker, and Ponderosa and Bonanza Steakhouses, spanning more than 1,700 units worldwide.


The Community Marketing Coordinator is an integral part of the Fatburger Marketing team at FAT brands, responsible for bringing the brand to life at the local restaurant level. This role combines hands\-on execution with strategic problem\-solving, helping franchisees identify and activate marketing opportunities that drive traffic, build community connections, and support profitable sales growth.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, with the ability to manage the details while also seeing the bigger picture. They should be comfortable working directly with franchises, navigating multiple priorities, and finding creative solutions when a playbook doesn't already exist.


This role will support local store marketing problems, new restaurant openings, community events, franchisee marketing requests and local partnerships while using market, competitive and sales insights to identify opportunities and recommend effective local marketing strategies.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  



* Assist in developing and executing local marketing plans that drive awareness, traffic and profitable sales, tailored to individual restaurant and market needs.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day marketing resource to franchisees, helping identify opportunities, develop market\-specific strategies and execute events, partnerships and community initiatives.
* Coordinate New Restaurant Marketing Plans and all marketing\-related activities from pre\-opening through launch.
* Lead local activations, events, and partnerships while ensuring all marketing remains on\-brand and aligned with broader Fatburger objectives.
* Coordinate creative requests from intake through final delivery, provide guidance on best practices and ensure franchisees have the tools and resources needed to execute effectively.
* Leverage sales, market and competitive data to identify opportunities, measure results and inform future local marketing strategies.
* Assists the Digital Team with CRM platforms, including websites, SMS, e\-clubs, and app\-based loyalty programs.
* Responsible for maintaining and updating ship lists, store location lists, and location listings management tools.
* Maintain budgets, project timelines, store/location information, marketing resources and other tools necessary to keep local programs organized and moving forward.
* Assists with Administrative Duties such as maintaining a budget, agendas, notes, and action items for meetings.


Requirements:  



* 2\+ years of marketing, local store marketing, franchise marketing, restaurant marketing or agency experience preferred.
* Experience working with franchisees, field teams, operators, or multiple stakeholders is a plus.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both corporate teams and franchise partners.
* Highly resourceful and solutions\-oriented; comfortable figuring things out, navigating ambiguity and taking initiatives without being asked.
* Strategic thinker who can understand a business challenge, identify opportunities and recommend practical marketing solutions
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through, with the ability to move projects from idea to execution
* Comfortable working with basic sales, market and competitive data translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the confidence to work directly with franchisees and restaurant operators
* Creative thinker who understands how to make a national brand relevant within individual communities
* Proficiency with project management and marketing tools; experience with Asana, Google Business Profile, social platforms, CRM/loyalty platforms and third\-party delivery platforms is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

Location \- Burbank, CA \- onsite



Rate \- $30/hr \- $33/hr



Client \- LTM

jobs.title: Community Coordinator for Music Instrument Manufacturer
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

NUX Audio (pronounced as "New\-X") is a music\-technology brand that offers a broad range of audio and music products, including guitar and bass effects, stompboxes, multi\-effects, amplifiers, wireless systems, digital drums, digital pianos, digital wind instruments, home studio/recording gear, and accessories.

NUX sits at the intersection of **innovation, value, and usability**. NUX offers professional\-grade music and audio gear at remarkable value, designed for real\-world use across practice, performance, and recording.

**Job Overview**

As our **Community Coordinator**, you’ll help represent NUX directly within the musician community while handling key day\-to\-day digital marketing responsibilities. Reporting to the Digital Marketing Manager, this role will focus on community engagement, customer communication, email marketing, content support, and creator research.

A major part of the role is engaging with customers and musicians across social media, forums, and online communities, answering product questions, responding to customer concerns, and joining conversations about music gear in an authentic and knowledgeable way.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Answer product and gear\-related questions accurately and conversationally
* Engage with musicians in relevant forums, groups, and online communities
* Proactively identify conversations and opportunities for NUX to engage with musicians online
* Help troubleshoot basic product questions and direct more technical issues to the appropriate team
* Handle day\-to\-day email marketing, including creating, writing, scheduling, and sending newsletters, product launches, promotions, firmware announcements, and other campaigns
* Maintain the email marketing calendar and coordinate campaigns with the Digital Marketing Manager
* Help grow and maintain the NUX email subscriber list through campaigns, sign\-up opportunities, and other audience\-building initiatives
* Monitor email performance, including open rates, click\-through rates, subscriber growth, and other key metrics
* Use campaign data and audience insights to improve email content, timing, targeting, and overall performance
* Test subject lines, messaging, calls to action, and other campaign elements to identify what resonates with the audience
* Research musicians, creators, artists, and potential KOL partners for collaborations
* Assist with social content creation, including short\-form video, product demonstrations, photography, and behind\-the\-scenes content
* Assist with product and lifestyle photoshoots and video shoots
* Help maintain a consistent and knowledgeable NUX brand voice across customer and community interactions
* Stay current on music gear, industry trends, competing products, and conversations happening within the musician community

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Must actively play at least one musical instrument**
* **Strong knowledge of music gear and musician culture is required**
* Comfortable discussing music gear and technology, including pedals, amps, modelers, keyboards, MIDI, recording equipment, wireless systems, signal chains, and related products
* **Previous marketing experience is not required for the right candidate. Strong music gear knowledge, communication skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are more important.**
* Previous customer service or customer support experience is a plus
* Experience in music retail, live sound, recording, performing, content creation, or another music industry environment is a plus
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain gear and technical information clearly
* Comfortable communicating directly with customers and handling questions or complaints professionally
* Familiarity with social media platforms and online musician communities
* Comfortable learning email marketing tools, analytics, and performance reporting
* Able to look at campaign data and use it to make informed decisions
* Able to communicate naturally with musicians without sounding overly corporate or scripted
* Strong research skills and an ability to identify relevant creators, artists, and online communities
* Basic photo or video editing skills are a plus, but not required
* Organized, proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable learning new tools and responsibilities
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team while also working independently

**Music gear knowledge is more important for this position than a traditional marketing background. Applicants who do not actively play a musical instrument or have a strong working knowledge of music gear and musician culture will not be considered.**

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

* Work with a globally recognized brand in music technology
* Spend your day working with music, gear, and the musician community
* Work directly with new products, artists, creators, and musicians
* Learn email marketing, community management, content creation, and creator partnerships hands\-on
* Contribute ideas to campaigns, content, and community strategy
* Opportunity to grow with the brand and take on additional responsibility over time
* Be part of a team that genuinely loves music and the gear that makes it possible
* Health Insurance, Vision Insurance, Paid Vacation, potential bonus structure for full time employees.

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: $22\.27 \- $23\.13 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* What can you tell us about your background/interest in the music industry (what instruments you play, related projects you've been part of, etc.)?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

PAR Apparel is seeking an organized, detail\-oriented Production Coordinator to support our apparel production team. This position plays an important role in coordinating production orders, samples, approvals, and production timelines from initial purchase order through shipment.

The ideal candidate has strong follow\-up skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced apparel environment. This role works closely with Production, Technical Design, Design, and Sales to help ensure samples and production approvals are completed accurately and on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and maintain garment purchase orders (POs).
* Coordinate Dot Com Exclusive/stock programs for company brands.
* Follow up with vendors and factories on Pre\-Production (PP) samples and approvals.
* Review PP samples for quality, color, components, labels, hangers, sizers, and other required details before submitting them to the SVP of Technical Design for review.
* Follow up on Top of Production (TOP) samples at approximately 10% of production.
* Review TOP samples for quality, color, components, labels, hangers, sizers, and other required details before submitting them to the SVP of Technical Design.
* Receive, review, and coordinate comments on production submits in partnership with Sales and/or Design.
* Prepare production submits for customers as needed and follow up on comments and approvals.
* Follow up on salesman samples, Dot Com samples, and other special\-request samples.
* Maintain accurate Time \& Action (T\&A) calendars for assigned programs, samples, and submits.
* Update and maintain Work\-in\-Progress (WIP) reports to ensure production status and approvals are current.
* Proactively identify issues or delays that may affect production timelines and escalate concerns as appropriate.
* Participate in weekly production meetings and communicate issues affecting T\&A timelines, approvals, or production.
* Recommend opportunities to improve production processes and workflow.
* Maintain organized production files and archive completed/shipped orders as needed.
* Escalate approval delays, production issues, or other concerns that may impact delivery to the SVP of Production.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to help ensure production requirements, deadlines, and customer expectations are met.
* Assist with additional projects or responsibilities based on business and department needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in apparel production, production coordination, product development, or a related apparel role preferred.
* Understanding of the apparel production process, including PP samples, TOP samples, production submits, and approvals.
* Experience working with garment purchase orders, T\&A calendars, and WIP reports preferred.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Production, Technical Design, Design, Sales, vendors, and factories.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to identify and escalate potential production delays.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other standard business applications.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven apparel environment.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented. The successful candidate will be comfortable following up consistently, keeping production information current, identifying potential delays, and communicating effectively across departments to keep programs moving forward.

Please note: Depending on business needs, there may be occasions when assistance with other areas, responsibilities, or special projects is requested.

Pay: $32\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Operations & Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator (Travel/Remote)** **Sullivan on Comp** is a subscription\-based legal research and technology platform serving the California workers’ compensation industry. The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a proactive, highly organized **Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for new\-business development. The primary focus of this role is to support revenue\-generating sales activity. Pipeline prioritization, prospect follow\-up, trial engagement, re\-engagement, and business\-development support will take precedence over routine CRM cleanup and administrative tasks when priorities compete.  

This position combines HubSpot and pipeline management with prospect research, trial engagement, outbound follow\-up, sales campaigns, and business\-development support.
The successful candidate will help ensure that promising opportunities receive consistent attention, stale opportunities are identified and appropriately re\-engaged, and the Account Executive can spend more time on substantive sales conversations, demonstrations, relationship development, and closing. **Compensation:**  

* $32 – $38/hour ($66,560 – $79,040 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
 **Travel \& Work Location**  

* Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
* Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.

 **Daily Objectives**  

* Manage and prioritize the HubSpot sales pipeline, ensuring accurate deal, activity, forecast, and next\-step data while identifying high\-priority opportunities for Account Executive focus.
* Monitor active trials and prospect engagement, conduct outreach via phone and email, gather feedback, and schedule demonstrations, training sessions, and follow\-up meetings.
* Research target organizations, decision\-makers, and market opportunities within the California workers’ compensation industry using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other business intelligence tools.
* Re\-engage dormant leads, inactive opportunities, former customers, and trial users through targeted email, phone, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Support outbound business development efforts by booking qualified meetings and advancing prospects toward substantive sales conversations.
* Assist with HubSpot sequences, workflows, lead segmentation, webinars, re\-engagement initiatives, and targeted marketing campaigns while monitoring campaign performance.
* Leverage sales intelligence and CRM data to identify follow\-up priorities, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to improve pipeline progression.
* Maintain detailed records of sales activities, prepare meeting briefings, track follow\-up commitments, coordinate proposals, and support accurate forecasting and reporting.
* Collaborate with Account Management, Marketing, Customer Service, and other internal teams to support customer acquisition and revenue growth initiatives.
* Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through planning, on\-site participation, lead capture, post\-event follow\-up, and business travel as needed.
 **Skills \& Experience**  

* 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
* Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.

 **Health \& Wellness**  

* Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO
* Dental coverage through **Delta Dental** with DHMO and PPO options
* **Vision** coverage through VSP
* Firm\-Paid **Life/AD\&D** (up to $150k) \& Long\-term Disability (**LTD**) Insurance.
* Firm\-Paid Employee Assistance Program (**EAP**) offering confidential support.
 **Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.
* **Critical Illness**, **Accident**, and **Hospital Indemnity Coverage**, available at group rates.
* Flexible Spending Account (**FSA**) and Dependent Care Assistance Program (**DCAP**) options for eligible pre\-tax expenses.
* Voluntary short\-term disability (**STD**) coverage.
* Supplemental **Life and AD\&D Insurance**.
* Optional **Pet Insurance**, because family comes in many forms.
 *Sullivan on Comp provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic makeup, marital status, military service, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

jobs.title: Service Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and customer\-focused Service Account Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain positive relationships within assigned customer accounts, overseeing the sales process, and acting as the primary point of contact to retain and grow these accounts. You will maintain regular communication with customers, coordinate with the Service team to ensure satisfaction, promptly address concerns and advocate for customers when performance or billing issues arise. Assigned accounts are generally larger and more complex.


**Position Details**


* Primarily responsible for growing our overall service business by prospecting in assigned market territory to develop and cultivate new “existing building” “owner direct” customers.
* Primary goal is to sell new service maintenance agreements and truck\-based service and project work.
* Proactively manages the service sales process to close sales, including prospecting, qualifying, customer’s setup and procurement process, proposals, presentations, as well as handling questions and objections.
* Develops and maintains positive relationships within assigned customer accounts. Oversees the sales process and acts as a “One Southland” point of contact for customers, engaging any internal teams or support necessary to allow for additional business development.
* Continuously generates new sales by using existing and potential customer networks and social networking. Identifies new business opportunities acting as the customer’s building solutions partner for all areas of locally provided service offerings.
* Mentors less\-experienced Service Account Managers.


**Qualifications**


* Two\-year relevant degree or equivalent training and experience, such as trade\-level training or industry experience
* 3\+ years in direct relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of service policies, procedures and capabilities
* Strong verbal and written communication, including presentation skills
* Strong customer service skills and ability to develop customer relationships
* Demonstrated sales skills in prospecting, qualifying, proposing and closing sales and capable of developing and managing large accounts (existing and new)
* Strong collaboration skills internally and externally, with strong problem\-solving abilities
* Frequent travel to job sites within assigned region
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Solid knowledge of CRM

As a 100% employee\-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family:


* 401(k) plan with **50% company match (no cap)** and immediate 100% vesting
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance **(100% paid for employee)**
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability
* Term life, AD\&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance
* Disability income protection insurance
* Pre\-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care)
* **Paid parental leave**
* Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time
* Training/professional development opportunities and company\-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses
* Wellness benefits

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager-SGWS West Admin
jobs.description:
The Wine Group (TWG) is a leading producer of award\-winning wines and alcoholic beverages across 120\+ brands. With operations in California, New York and Australia, TWG is an innovator in developing and marketing brands beloved by consumers globally, including Cupcake, Franzia, Benziger, Imagery, Tribute, Chloe, Meiomi, Cooks, 7 Deadly, Cooper \& Thief, and more. We produce our products using sustainable practices to create delicious beverages that people can feel good about. Visit us at www.thewinegroup.com.
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
  

The Regional Account Manager – Western Region is responsible for executing TWG’s National Account Strategy across the entire TWG portfolio within both independent liquor accounts and regional grocery / convenience/ small format accounts. This role will partner with the TWG Field Sales Organization (FSO) to optimize program execution with wholesalers. They will develop and implement annual strategic plans to expand TWG’s presence within each retail chain and establish measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that drive brand growth. Additionally, they will ensure execution levels align with TWG’s Annual Operating Plan (AOP), delivering strong results and positioning TWG for continued success in the region. The ideal candidate will live in the Southern California area.
  
  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

* Develop, lead, and ensure execution of TWG’s strategy related to our agreed AOP plan for Regional Account Universe
* Responsible for delivering Region Account AOP Plan, Scorecard objectives and KPI’s.
* Build relationships with regional chain buyers and all key decision makers in each account. Build quality relationships with Director/VP of Regional Chains at wholesaler as well as the KAMs and Execution teams.
* Understand TWG new item initiatives and how to prioritize them for each customer based on their individual go\-to\-market strategy.
* Translate national strategy into localized execution plans, tailored to their retailers.
* Conduct monthly program presentations against TWG priorities and chain specific opportunities; maximize TWG share of merchandising activity.
* Create and sell high impact Trade Marketing programs.
* Supports Field Sales to maximize program execution through all key phases: Planning\-Communication\-Execution\-Evaluation.
* Manage budgets in the following categories: Pricing, Incentives, Coupons, Demos and Tasting, Travel and Entertainment expenses.
* Handle administration as required by each chain and TWG.
* This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* BA degree or equivalent experience and proficient skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Preferred 5 or more years of sales experience in the alcoholic beverage industry or related business with knowledge and passion for both commercial and premium wines.
* Must have strong understanding and working knowledge of alcoholic beverage industry retail environment.
* Intermediate wine knowledge or associated certifications preferred.
* Must be well organized with an ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment and be adaptive to change within organization and industry.
* Results oriented, innovation, strong problem solving and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work and succeed in dynamic entrepreneurial environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willing to travel with overnight stays as needed.
* Display integrity, character, and strong leadership skills.
* Support and model all company procedures and policies.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and with a team in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment with emphasis on accuracy and timeliness.
* Must have excellent safety, work performance, and attendance record.
* Prioritize while able to adapt to changing priorities.
* Demonstrated reliability and punctuality, work effectively in team/crew environment, adherence to all safety regulations and operating procedures.
* Embrace and demonstrate The Wine Group Core Values – Performance, Empowerment, and Cost\-Mindful, and utilize them for all decision making.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

jobs.title: Territory Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Territory Sales Account ManagerJob description:

Our company is a sanitation services company in the Western USA. We’re looking for an experienced Territory Sales Account Manager to build our large\-account presence in Orange County, California. This person will own the large General Contractor and large Event Company book in the territory — protecting and growing our existing relationships and hunting for new ones — while working closely with Operations to deliver on what we sell.

What You’ll Do

As Territory Sales Account Manager, you’ll own the top\-of\-market account development in Orange County — bringing large General Contractors and large Event Companies into the company on the strength of relationships and service, not just price. You’ll report to the Regional Director and partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team to make sure what you sell is what we deliver.

You’ll be responsible for:

**1\. Bring Large\-Scale Customers to the Company:**

* Own the target list of large General Contractors and large Event Companies in the Orange County territory — Superintendents, Project Managers, Estimators, Procurement, and Event Producers
* Build multi\-touchpoint relationships that go beyond a single buyer — deep, durable relationships that don’t reset every time a project ends or a person changes seats
* Position the company on value, service reliability, luxury trailer capability, and event execution — not on price alone
* Represent the company at industry events, association meetings, and customer\-hosted events (AGC, ABC, DBIA, ISES, ILEA, IAVM, industry chapters)
* Develop and maintain account plans for each named strategic account — pipeline, project outlook, renewal calendar, expansion opportunities, and risk
* Negotiate contracts, MSAs, and pricing agreements with support from the Regional Director
* Maintain a clean, current CRM with account contacts, project pipeline, and activity notes

**2\. Create New Relationships from Scratch:**

* Hunt for new accounts through cold outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, project research, trade shows, and industry associations
* Build a personal outreach cadence — targeted calls, emails, and in\-person visits — sufficient to generate a healthy new\-business pipeline
* Convert warm leads and inbound inquiries into first orders quickly and reliably
* Establish yourself as a known name in the Orange County construction and events community over your first 6–12 months
* Approach unfamiliar customers with confidence — cold calls, walk\-ins on job sites, and introductions at events
* Move accounts from first\-order to repeat\-customer through follow\-up, problem\-solving, and personal attention
* Work with Marketing and Business Development on lead generation, digital presence, and territory awareness

**3\. Collaborate Effectively with Operations:**

* Partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team on scheduling, service delivery, and customer communication
* Understand operational constraints — truck capacity, driver availability, service radius, plastics inventory, trailer availability, and lead times — before making commitments
* Never over\-promise on timing or scope; when a request is tight, work the tradeoff with Ops before committing to the customer
* Understand the pricing floor and margin expectations by service type; escalate below\-floor pricing rather than absorbing it
* Provide Ops with accurate order details — site access, hazards, timing, delivery windows, event schedules, permit needs
* Escalate scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or service risks to Ops and the customer before they become problems
* Communicate service issues back to customers proactively — own the customer relationship through the miss, not around it
* Debrief with Ops after service complaints or misses; close the loop and prevent repeat issues

Key Performance Indicators

* New named accounts won per quarter (large GC, large Event)
* Territory revenue growth vs. plan
* Gross margin on managed accounts (avoid winning on price alone)
* Pipeline coverage — active opportunities relative to quota
* Customer retention and expansion — dollars per account year over year
* Response time on customer inquiries and quotes
* CRM hygiene — accounts, contacts, activities, and forecast current
* Named\-account penetration — number of buying contacts per top account

Expectations

* Field\-forward posture — on job sites, at customer offices, at industry events, walking event venues
* Weekly pipeline review with the Regional Director; disciplined forecasting
* Direct, honest communication with both customers and internal partners
* Comfort with rejection and tenacity through long sales cycles typical of large GC accounts
* Ownership of customer outcomes — from first quote through renewal
* Alignment with and reinforcement of company Mission, Vision, and Values

Requirements

* 5\+ years of business\-to\-business sales experience with a proven record of hitting new\-business quotas
* **Must have:** experience selling portable toilets and portable sanitation services into the Construction industry, Event industry, or both
* Established network of relationships with Orange County General Contractors, Event Producers, or both
* Bathroom trailer / luxury restroom trailer sales experience preferred
* Strong hunting skills — cold outreach, prospecting, and comfort approaching new customers
* Ability to sell on value, service, and relationship rather than lowest price
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Proficiency in CRM tools; disciplined about pipeline and activity tracking
* Willingness to travel throughout the Orange County territory and adjacent markets as needed
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Commitment to safety, quality, and customer service

Compensation:

* Competitive base salary plus commission tied to new\-business acquisition, revenue growth

Competitive Hourly \+ Bonus

Great culture where you work with the founders and key stakeholders in a relaxed, but innovative atmosphere.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

  

The Client Relationship Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day service and management of a book of employer\-sponsored retirement plans, including 401(k) and 403(b) plans. The position serves as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors and coordinates all work involving the recordkeeper, third\-party administrator, plan auditor, payroll provider, and HUB's internal investment and financial planning teams.

  

The Client Relationship Manager interacts regularly with CFOs, HR Directors, controllers, business owners, and retirement plan committees, and also serves as a resource to plan participants. The position is service\- and retention\-focused rather than production\-focused, though the Client Relationship Manager is expected to identify plan design, compliance, and financial wellness opportunities within the assigned book and bring them to the client for consideration.

  

This is a hands\-on role on a small team, and the Client Relationship Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership as part of a collaborative practice. This includes managing their own calendar, scheduling client and vendor meetings, answering and returning calls, submitting expense reports, and coordinating client gifting within firm guidelines. The position does not assume dedicated administrative or support staff. The expectation is that this person identifies what needs to be done and acts on it, and brings a recommended course of action rather than only flagging the problem. Beyond the assigned book, the Client Relationship Manager is expected to contribute to the strength and efficiency of the overall practice.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**New Client Onboarding and Implementation**
--------------------------------------------

* Manage the onboarding process for new advisory clients, including Broker of Record (BOR) paperwork, advisory and consulting agreements, 408(b)(2\) disclosures, vendor authorization and system access forms, and adoption of the Investment Policy Statement.
* Develop and manage the onboarding project plan, coordinate vendor deliverables and deadlines, and provide status updates to the client.
* Establish the ongoing service calendar for each relationship, including committee meeting cadence, compliance milestones, and the participant education schedule.
* Coordinate the rollout of HUB's financial wellness and financial coaching program (FinPath by HUB), including implementation planning, sponsor and employee communications, ongoing promotion, and engagement reporting.
* Support new business proposals and RFP responses for prospective retirement plan clients, including plan data compilation, vendor comparison, and preparation of client\-facing materials, as directed.

**Ongoing Client Service and Relationship Management**
------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the plan sponsor on all matters relating to the retirement plan.
* Review inbound correspondence from recordkeepers, TPAs, auditors, and other plan vendors; determine required action; resolve items directly with the vendor; and involve the client only where a sponsor decision or signature is required.
* Escalate and track unresolved service issues with recordkeeper and TPA service teams through resolution.
* Coordinate quarterly and annual investment review and plan committee meetings with HUB's investment team, including scheduling, agenda preparation, materials, logistics, meeting minutes, and follow\-up item tracking.
* Maintain the client fiduciary file, including meeting minutes, Investment Policy Statement, fee benchmarking documentation, plan documents, participant notices, and vendor disclosures.
* Own the integrity of all client and plan records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 for the assigned book, including contact information, fee schedules, service agreement terms, compliance deadlines, and activity history. Records should be current, complete, and usable by any team member at any time.

**Vendor Relationships**
------------------------

* Serve as the team's primary relationship contact for assigned recordkeepers and TPAs, independent of any specific client event or service issue.
* Attend and represent the team in recordkeeper and TPA relationship meetings, quarterly business reviews, and platform update briefings.
* Maintain a current directory of vendor contacts across service, relationship management, and escalation, and keep team\-level platform access and credentialing current.

**Plan Design and Plan Document Maintenance**
---------------------------------------------

* Maintain a working knowledge of qualified plan design sufficient to discuss design alternatives with clients and to identify circumstances in which a design change should be considered — for example, a plan consistently failing or narrowly passing nondiscrimination testing, resulting in corrective refunds to highly compensated employees.
* Work with the plan's TPA to obtain census\-based cost projections for proposed design changes, such as a safe harbor match, an increase or restructuring of the employer match, or the addition of a profit sharing or new comparability allocation, and present the results to the client.
* Manage the plan amendment process from identification through implementation: coordinate drafting with the recordkeeper or TPA, review amendment language against the client's stated intent, obtain client execution, and confirm that the recordkeeper and TPA have implemented the change in the plan document and in their administrative systems.
* Manage required restatements and amendments, including the SECURE 2\.0 restatement cycle, through client review, sign\-off, and execution.
* Prepare and coordinate distribution of related participant notices, including safe harbor, QDIA, automatic enrollment and escalation, blackout, summary of material modifications, and annual fe

Our mission is to build the next\-gen CRM. As a BDR your main objective is to be the first spark for our future customers, turning cold curiosity into momentum from first hello to discovery call.


**Competencies**
----------------


This is not about ticking boxes or tallying years of experience. It is something deeper. The people who thrive here share a few things:


* **Curiosity**: Always learning, and learning quickly, whether it's about new prospects, our product, technology, client success, or the sales process. Open to feedback and thriving on it.
* **Perceptive and focused:** Alert to what people say, with a knack for asking the right questions and listening intently. Extraordinary communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* **Results driven:** Setting clear goals and achieving them. Self\-motivated to succeed, and to succeed in the right way. Creating relationships and deals that last.

Our existing team come from diverse backgrounds, but a few things tie us together:


* A proven track record of at least 12 months in B2B sales, SDR, BDR, or talent acquisition
* A strong academic background, usually with standout extracurricular achievements
* A desire to take on a bigger challenge and a no excuses mindset

**Trajectory**
--------------


You will have responsibility from the get\-go, and an accelerated career path awaits. Within Planhat, we're the engine room that drives growth. For our prospective customers, we're the front\-of\-house and the all important first introduction to the company. The BDR team are comfortable blending long\-term thinking and short\-term pragmatism, whether:


* Identifying prospects and conducting outreach through calls, emails, and LinkedIn
* Building strong relationships with post\-sales leaders across our key markets
* Qualifying, then prioritizing the needs and aspirations of executives across different industries, seniority levels, and company sizes
* Laying the groundwork for customer discovery calls for Account Executives with prospects across SMB, Mid\-market, and Enterprise

From there the path accelerates. You progress toward more senior roles and greater responsibility, with a clear route toward becoming an Account Executive. You build entrepreneurial skills at the forefront of a growing business rather than reading about it, take on leadership opportunities as the team scales, and gain exposure across markets and potentially across our offices in the USA and EMEA.  

  

  



**Definition of Success**
-------------------------


* You have taken on real responsibility from day one and earned the trust of the team around you
* You are consistently hitting and exceeding your meeting and pipeline targets
* You are generating high quality qualified pipeline that converts into discovery calls and revenue for Account Executives
* You are seen as a trusted partner by the AE team and by Customer Success leaders across your markets
* You are turning outreach into relationships and deals that last

----------------


The OTE (base \+ variable) salary range for this position is $75,000 \- $95,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

JANS Enterprises Corp has been a leading name in the food and beverage industry for over 27 years. We are a distributor and manufacturer supplying a wide range of fruit juices, biscuits, and snacks that are available in more than 1000 supermarkets across the United States. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives our continued growth and success.

**Job Summary**

We are on the lookout for an energetic and results\-driven Outside Sales Representative with bilingual skills to join our dynamic sales team to chase after supermarkets and grocery chains. In this role, you'll be the face of our brand, building strong relationships with clients and expanding our market reach. Your enthusiasm for business development, combined with your ability to manage territory sales and close deals, will help us grow further. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy connecting with people, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

**Responsibilities**

* Develop new business opportunities through prospecting, cold calling, and lead generation within assigned territories.
* Manage existing client accounts by nurturing relationships, providing excellent customer service, and identifying upselling opportunities.
* Present our products confidently to potential clients, demonstrating features and benefits tailored to their needs.
* Memorize and understand our extensive catalog
* Utilize CRM software and sales management systems to track activities, manage contacts, and analyze sales performance.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to develop strategies that increase brand awareness and generate leads.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of our product offerings, industry trends, and competitors to stay ahead in the market.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-2 years in outside sales or B2B sales, preferably in food wholesale industry or related sectors.
* Strong management skills with experience in business development and account management
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills to build lasting client relationships.
* Ability to work independently in a remote sales environment while meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Demonstrated success in territory management, prospecting, closing deals, and achieving sales goals.
* Ability to learn a wide range of products and adapt along the way
* Capable of traveling 2\-3 weeks of the month to visit clients and secure clients

**Preferred Skills**

* Bilingual skills are highly preferred to effectively communicate with diverse client bases(Mandarin, Tagalog, Vietnamese preferred)
* Proficiency with CRM systems such as SAP and Pepperi or similar platforms for lead tracking and customer relationship management.
* Strong organizational and planning skills to ensure all customers are met on time

jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC\-II) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter\- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC\-II provides study management, support, and coordination for FDA regulated research industry\-sponsored, government funded, and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials. This may include blood collection, data and trials that have therapeutic or device component. The CRC\-II ensures smooth, accurate process of clinical studies from the planning, implementation, and post\-study closure procedures.


The CRC\-II is involved in all aspects of the clinical research process included, but no limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, development of study treatment plans, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, and regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators.


He/she will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting and scheduled subject follow\-up visits. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub\-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent.


Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC\-II will record protocol specific assessments and treatments, ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. I. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned.


Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.


  
**Education and Experience*** High School Diploma with 2\-3 years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.

**License Required:**N/A


**License Preferred:**N/A


**Certifications Required**N/A


**Certifications Preferred**May only perform blood draws by meeting and maintaining State of California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) Certification

Advanced Management Company is a property management company, which was started in 1982 and built on a foundation of ethical business practices. **Job Title:** Community Manager


**Pay:** $ per hour, plus commission


**Job Summary:**


The role of an AMC Community Manager requires high energy, a burning desire to make a difference in people’s lives and a commitment to anticipate and exceed the expectations of our residents, prospective VIPs and co\-workers. This diverse role combines leasing, revenue and expense management, maintenance management, sales, customer service, marketing and leadership.


**Essential Job Duties:**

* Leads daily team meetings to uphold AMC Employee Promise and Vision Statement and outline priorities for the day in coordinance with Maintenance Supervisor.
* Walks the property daily to ensure curb appeal and prepare market window.
* Performs excellent telephone and presentation sales skills and delivers exceptional customer service while handling prospective residents including a property tour and follow up.

* Prepares or reviews leases and move\-in packets and coordinates move\-in process with new resident.

* Prepares move\-out paperwork on vacating residents and inspects vacant apartments with Service Director to determine any damages and schedule turnover maintenance required.
* Maintains thorough, organized, up\-to\-date and accurate resident files as well as renovation information input in MRI.
* Handles all monthly administrative tasks including but not limited to: collecting and posting rent, scanning bank deposits, preparing three day notices to pay rent or quit, supervising eviction proceedings, processing lease renewals and increases and reviewing financial budgets.
* Negotiates contracts, manages vendor performance, codes, approves and ensures vendor bills are submitted and paid on time through accounting system (AVID).
* Approve and report all payroll information in Kronos to the corporate office before the scheduled deadline.
* Complete employee evaluations and inspire people through vision and goals while setting individuals up for success through strong leadership and a career development plan.
* Conducts monthly safety meetings. Inspects the property regularly and report all safety hazards, damages and areas needing repair. Follow up to verify completion in compliance with OSHA, property insurance companies, company and risk management policies.

* Industry managerial experience.
* Knowledge with MRI, leasing, revenue and expense management, maintenance management, sales, customer service, marketing and leadership.
* Ability to score at or above AMC standards on mystery shop report.
* Respond to emergency phone calls.
* Available to work weekends.
* Proficient computer skills in MS Word, Excel and Outlook as well as Email, Internet and Social Media as it pertains to marketing of community.
* Well\-developed interpersonal, written and verbal reasoning and communication skills in English and ability to understand legal documentation and perform intermediate level mathematical calculations.
* Shows up to work on time, follows direction from Regional Director, interacts well with coworkers and residents and gives and receives feedback.
* Maintains a professional image and attitude at all times; observing the policies and procedures of AMC when conducting business with prospects, residents and vendors.
* Remarkable sales skills in demonstrating features, benefits and closing.
* Serve our VIPs with a welcoming and caring attitude.
* Behave in a responsible, professional and ethical manner with exceptional time management, multi\-tasking and leadership skills. Demonstrate personal and professional integrity at all times.
* Must be assertive, independent, energetic, flexible, motivated, goal oriented, driven and organized.
* Must maintain reliable transportation daily, valid driver’s license and valid vehicle insurance.
* Physical ability to bend, stretch, reach, grasp, stand, sit, walk and climb stairs for long periods of time before taking a break.

jobs.description:

At BRAVAS, we transform homes into extraordinary living experiences. As the nation’s \#1 luxury technology integrator, we design and deliver premium solutions \- lighting, shades, A/V, networking, home automation, and more, that make life effortless, beautiful, and connected.


We partner with homeowners, architects, builders, and designers on some of the most spectacular homes in the country. And we’re growing.

**The Role**


The Project Coordinator \& Scheduler sits at the center of project execution, supporting Project Managers, coordinating technician schedules across multiple concurrent jobs, and serving as the communication link between clients, field teams, and internal departments. This role is equal parts logistics, coordination, and follow\-through, and embodies our six core values: collaborative, accountable, proactive, curious, passionate, and creative.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports Project Managers with day\-to\-day project activities, documentation, change orders, and milestone tracking.
* Builds and manages installation and technician schedules across multiple projects, assigning resources based on scope, location, and skillset.
* Monitors resource availability and adjusts schedules proactively in response to delays, scope changes, or conflicts.
* Coordinates with warehouse and logistics teams to align technician schedules with material delivery timelines.
* Tracks procurement and ensures timely delivery of equipment and materials to job sites.
* Acts as a central communication point between clients, project managers, subcontractors, and field teams.
* Schedules client meetings, site walks, and punch list closeouts; communicates project scope and schedule updates to all stakeholders.
* Produces daily/weekly dispatch summaries, project timeline updates, resource utilization reports, and closeout documentation.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in project coordination, scheduling, or operations; construction, technology, or field services a plus.
* Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Asana, or Monday.com.
* Experience with ERP or project management platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, or Procore.
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for scheduling, reporting, and tracking.
* Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Clear communicator, able to work effectively with technicians, managers, and clients alike.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a desk or computer.
* Occasional travel to job sites for scheduling coordination and site walks.

**Bravas Benefits**

* Be part of something premium: Work with the nation’s leader in smart home integration.
* Collaborative culture: A fun, supportive team that celebrates wins together.
* Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to the luxury design/build community and grow your career in project management.
* Competitive perks: Base salary ($25\-$35/hour)\+ bonuses, medical/dental/vision, 401(k), PTO, and more.

If you’re hungry to grow, love being out in the field, and are excited about bringing luxury experiences to life, we’d love to meet you. Apply today and let’s make something extraordinary together.

jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

  

Do you love taking on big challenges without precedent? Do you possess a deep knowledge of the legal field and a passion for innovation? We have a phenomenal new opportunity for Political Compliance Program Specialist.  

  

**Description**  

  

Apple’s Political Compliance team is looking for an organized and quick\-thinking individual with good judgment. Political Compliance is part of the Compliance and Business Conduct team, and helps ensure that Apple’s interactions with public employees and officials comply with ethics, anti\-corruption, lobbying and campaign finance regulations around the world. The ideal candidate will have a working knowledge of political compliance regulations with strong program management skills to build scalable processes, track deadlines, manage inputs, and drive continuous improvement.","responsibilities":"Implement and maintain compliance workflows, tracking systems, and internal controls for lobbying registration and reporting.  

  

Track, review and approve events involving public employees and officials to determine what hospitality is permissible to provide and reportable using guidelines provided by legal counsel.  

  

Research regulations and policies related to ethics, gifts and conflicts of interest.  

  

Clearly communicate approvals and instructions to employees for events following our standard process, and make sure all supporting documentation is filed.  

  

Draft and send follow\-up communications for individuals who attend events and either need to reimburse for items received or need a detailed accounting for disclosure purposes. This will include pulling together expenses from different internal stakeholders, drafting letters with reimbursement instructions or expense breakdowns, and sending the communications to external third parties.  

  

Manage a master compliance calendar, ensuring all filing deadlines are tracked and met while assisting with collecting, reviewing, and compiling information needed for all internal and external reporting.  

  

Support vendor and outside counsel relationships necessary for meeting all deadlines.  

  

Review emails that come in to the group inbox and respond or direct to attorneys as appropriate.  

  

Manage internal tools and databases including owning project timelines for compliance initiatives and updates using project management tools to track milestones and deliverables.  

  

Maintain accurate records and documentation to support compliance needs.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Ability to work independently and with a variety of business teams and build relationships to drive success.  

  

Technical understanding/abilities preferred, as will assist in assessing internal and external tools and capabilities.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Candidate should have a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of three years of experience in a corporate or law firm setting.  

  

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities simultaneously.  

  

Experience building, managing and updating internal team process and reference documents.  

  

Experience designing and driving programmatic improvements with a goal of growing team efficiency and building automation where appropriate.  

  

Clear verbal and written communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.  

  

Ability to take ownership of projects and drive them to completion.  

  

Demonstrated program or project management experience, including planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $140,700 and $211,400, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Plumbing Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About Bell Bros:**



At Bell Brothers Plumbing, Heating \& Air, we are your gateway to a rewarding career in HVAC and plumbing services! We are proud to be a leading provider of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, windows, and plumbing solutions, and we believe that our success is rooted in the dedicated and passionate team members who make it all possible. We offer a culture of excellence, professional growth and development, cutting\-edge technology and tools, a strong team environment, and competitive compensation and benefits.


**Job Overview:**



The Plumbing Sales Representative generates and secures plumbing sales through various leads, ensuring customer satisfaction and company growth. This position involves accurate job bidding, maintaining strong customer relationships, and meeting sales quotas. The role reports to the Install Manager and requires working closely with field technicians and supervisors.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Sales Generation:** Conduct outside sales to both club and non\-club customers, focusing on the Plumbing Safety Inspection and sewer/ drain department.
* **Brand Representation:** Serve as a brand ambassador, maintaining a professional demeanor and adhering to company policies while operating company vehicles.
* **Job Management:** Monitor plumbing repair, sewer and re\-pipe jobs daily to ensure they progress as planned and meet contractual timelines.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Field Drain Techs, Sewer Supervisors, PSI technicians and Sales Coordinators to provide accurate solutions and meet customer and company objectives.
* **Customer Relations:** Resolve contractual and job performance concerns with customers and Supervisors, maintaining a customer\-oriented focus.
* **Technical Skills:** Demonstrate knowledge of general plumbing, camera operation, drain issues, and installation methods using standard tools and equipment.


**Qualifications and Skills**


* Minimum of 2 years of residential plumbing experience.
* Solid understanding of plumbing concepts, water distribution, and disposal systems.
* Ability to follow oral and written directions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Friendly, approachable, and capable of promoting a positive company image.
* Team\-oriented with a willingness to support all areas of the business.
* Analytical, focused on quality, and results\-driven.
* Physically capable of handling workload requirements.
* Clean driving record and valid driver's license.
* Successful completion of pre\-employment screenings and physical examinations.


**Physical Demands**


* Regular sitting, handling, feeling, and typing.
* Frequent communication through talking and listening.
* Occasional standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling.
* Ability to lift and move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities, including close, distance, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.


**Benefits**


* Company vehicle provided.
* Tools provided.
* Company cellphone.
* 401K retirement plan.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Paid vacation and holidays.

  



\#BELLP

We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
