jobs.title: Licensing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Our Company**



VIZ Media has been bringing the finest in manga, anime, and global entertainment to English\-speaking fans across the world for nearly 40 years. From classic series like Dragon Ball, Sailor Moon, and Naruto to current hits like My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer, and Chainsaw Man, we continue to offer the best in action, romance, fantasy, and adventure stories for fans of all ages.



Our critically acclaimed manga, graphic novels, and books have won Eisner, YALSA, and Hugo awards and are available in both print and digital editions, and our premier catalog of anime titles can be seen on TV and via streaming and digital download, as well as in collectible Blu\-ray and DVD sets at major retailers.



Learn more about VIZ Media, anime, and manga at www.viz.com.

**Job Summary**



VIZ Media, the world leader in English\-language versions of manga and anime (Japanese comics and animation), is looking for a Licensing Coordinator to support our CPG Licensing \& Promotions department. The Licensing Coordinator supports the Consumer Products Licensing team by coordinating day\-to\-day licensing operations across multiple entertainment properties and licensed categories. This role serves as a central point of coordination between internal departments, licensors, licensing agents, and licensees to ensure licensing deals, approvals, reporting, and product lifecycles progress efficiently and on schedule. The Licensing Coordinator manages deal workflow, tracks approvals, prepares presentations and business materials, and supports partner, licensor, and cross\-functional communications. This position is ideal for a highly organized, detail\-oriented individual looking to build a career in consumer products licensing, entertainment, or brand management.


**What you'll do:**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative support for the Consumer Products Licensing team across multiple product categories and territories.
* Prepare Deal Memos and supporting documentation for internal and licensor approval.
* Track licensing opportunities from deal submission through execution using internal project management systems.
* Maintain accurate records of licensees, agreements, product categories, approvals, reporting, and key business milestones.
* Coordinate execution of licensing agreements with Licensing, Contracts, Finance, and external partners.
* Monitor renewal timelines and contract expiration dates, proactively notifying Licensing Managers of upcoming deadlines.
* Assist in onboarding new licensees
* Serve as a liaison between licensees, licensing agents, licensors, and internal departments including Contracts, Product Development, Brand Assurance/Approvals, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.
* Track approval timelines and follow up with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
* Assist with overdue payment and forecast reconciliation.
* Coordinate sample requests for licensors, partners, internal stakeholders, and marketing initiatives


In addition to these responsibilities, perform other activities as assigned.


**The ideal candidate has:**


* 1–3 years of experience in licensing, consumer products, entertainment, or administrative support.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, My Media Box, Canva, Asana, and Slack.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and external partners.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Nice to have:**


* Japanese language proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) strongly preferred.
* Experience working with licensors or international business partners.
* Experience with royalty reporting or licensing administration.


**Work Environment \& Schedule**



Location: The Licensing Coordinator position is open to candidates local to the San Francisco Bay Area. VIZ Media operates on a hybrid schedule, and the Licensing Coordinator should expect to work onsite at our Downtown San Francisco office 2 times per week. There may be some required travel for this position to attend conventions or trade shows.



Schedule: This is a Regular Full\-Time position with flexibility in working hours outside of our core hours of 10:00am \- 4:00pm.



Compensation: $65,000 \- $75,000 annually, depending on experience, with additional variable compensation

  

**VIZ Media offers the following benefits to its eligible employees:**


* Partially subsidized Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) savings plan – including employer matching
* Flexible Spending – health and dependent care
* Commuter stipend for in\-office work
* Life Insurance/AD\&D/STD/LTD
* Legal \& ID Theft insurance
* Group Pet insurance rates
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time \- plus your birthday is a holiday!
* Philanthropy program, including paid time off for volunteer work
* Wellness program, including fitness membership discounts and reimbursement
* Full time casual dress
* Flexible work hours

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**


Sales Department

*Job Description*  

  



**Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.


The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role.

 **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

**Multiple Locations**: United States

**Compensation**: Competitive Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission (60/40 OTE Split \+ Performance Accelerators)

**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts
* Expand sales (upsell) in assigned accounts by introducing new products and services
* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled
* Monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, new products, delivery schedules, and merchandising techniques
* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed




**Position Requirements**


* BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Netsuite/ERP, Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------



**Grow with us!**  

HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated security solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities.  

**About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services.
* Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives.
* Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs.
* Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth.
* Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education.
* Develop business opportunities by conducting needs assessments and constructing winning proposals for system installation and service opportunities.
* Develop financial justifications, perform takeoffs, prepare estimates and proposals, make presentations, and perform the necessary follow\-up for a successful closing of the sale.
* Build market awareness through networking, presentations, event attendance, and industry associations.
* Partner with operations personnel to execute growth, development, sales, and marketing strategies.
* Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Associate degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or engineering preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of demonstrated successful sales in the security integration industry, general construction, or electrical construction industry.
* Comprehensive industry knowledge of security integration solutions and/or other related low voltage systems.
* Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities, as well as handle complex, large\-scale accounts and high\-value contracts.
* Experience working with electrical contractors, general contractors, consultants, engineers or end users, with the ability to read construction blueprints and wiring diagrams.
* High degree of self\-discipline and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, using tact and diplomacy when dealing with customers.
* Must be reliable, self\-motivated, success\-driven, with excellent organizational, negotiating and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in industry\-related equipment including Windows, MS Office, and customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Applicants must meet requirements in relation to background, have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.
* Regular, reliable, predictable attendance.

***\*\*compensation range includes potential commissions earned on sales\*\****  

HCI Systems Inc. is a licensed C\-7, C\-10 and C\-16 low voltage systems integration contractor offering a full spectrum of services including sales, engineering, installation, service, and maintenance with over 600 employees in our seven branches. We offer fire life safety, fire suppression, fire sprinkler, access control, video management, intrusion detection, structured cable, nurse call and other related electronic detection solutions to our customers.  

**Why Join Us?**
* **Unlimited Growth** – Our expanding product lines and markets drive consistent double\-digit growth, creating ongoing opportunities for advancement.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Enjoy 401(k) with matching, reduced\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending accounts. Additional voluntary benefits include life insurance, disability, and accident coverage.
* **Paid Time Off** – Recharge with paid holidays and our PTO plan
* **Weekly Pay** – Get paid every Friday.
* **Employee Perks** – From appreciation events and department outings to wellness programs and pet insurance, we invest in our team’s well\-being.

**E*****qual Employment Opportunity***
*HCI is an equal opportunity employer. We will not unlawfully discriminate against qualified applicants or employees with respect to any terms and conditions of employment and give equal opportunity considerations to applicants and employees regardless of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances (“Protected Classifications”). jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**What to know**
----------------



Lead clients — and their teams — to greatness. In this role, you'll work to take our clients' complex problems, break them down into solvable pieces, and match them with Blue State' teams and expertise. You'll serve as a close partner to key clients, instinctively understanding their business challenges and translating them into briefs that inspire our strategy and delivery teams. You'll lead and facilitate smart conversations with a variety of organizations, challenging their thinking to ensure we deliver the best possible outcome. We value new approaches and perspectives and it's our priority to make space for your growth and development. If you want to advance your career by working with clients facing diverse challenges across a variety of industries, this is the place for you.


**The company**
---------------



Blue State is a purpose\-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

  

**The Team**
------------



Our Accounts and Project Management Team is at the heart of everything we do. Our charge is to take complex problems and break them down into solvable pieces. We are close partners with our clients, understanding their needs, worries and hopes and translating that into inspirational charges for our creative, strategy, and technology teams. We are intellectually curious and love to explore the use of new digital platforms and tools. Our energy and our passion for our work is contagious.


**A day in the life**
---------------------


* Coordinate delivery across multiple client accounts, driving the best strategy and/or execution to meet clients' needs in an agile and responsive way
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and understand project priorities in the context of agency and client expectations
* Coordinate and monitor the work of internal delivery teams to complete tasks on time and within budget
* Contribute to the production, delivery, and QA of emails, social media content, and web pages
* Plan, schedule, and estimate costs of new and existing business
* Draft client\-facing proposals and memoranda, presentations, strategic plans, and other internal or client\-facing materials
* Have a clear view of Blue State's various offerings and identify opportunities to add value and support clients' needs as they expand or change
* Have a finger on the pulse of cutting\-edge developments taking place in tech and digital organizing \- inviting opinions from peers and sharing our point of view with clients

**What we offer**
-----------------


* Unlimited time\-off (inclusive of sick, personal, and vacation days)
* $1,000 annually in professional development funds
* Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible and health savings accounts
* 401K \& employer match
* Generous paid holiday schedule
* 12\-week fully\-paid parental leave for all parents\-to\-be
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Remote work flexibility


We approach in\-office working with a hybrid model. On\-site presence is welcome for US staff who are within commuting distance of the NY or DC office. Managers retain discretion to require in\-person attendance for folks on their discipline or client teams as necessary, including for those whose roles require them to be in person.



The salary for this position is $74,750\.


**Some Things We're Looking For**
---------------------------------


* 3\+ years of relevant experience in client services, digital marketing, paid media, fundraising or a related area
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, team oriented mindset, attention to detail
* Experience with (or willingness to learn) project management tools and methodologies
* Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you.
* Experience project managing paid media campaigns (e.g. paid social, search advertising, or offline advertising)
* Teamwork and scrappiness required. You are adaptable, curious, and always looking for ways to make things more efficient.
* Whether it is Slack, Zoom, or email, you are a clear and responsive communicator. You approach communication with empathy and respect. You manage your time well and are excited to dive into multiple projects at once.
* A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we're always making progress.
* Ability to be resourceful, inspired, and self\-driven while jumping in to play different roles on a project.
* The ability to act as a role model at Blue State and embody our working agreements.


At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice\-to\-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don't think your current skill set checks every box, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.

  

Blue State is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible application and interview process. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a disability, including the use of AI tools throughout the hiring process, please contact us at recruiting@bluestate.co with the **subject line: Accommodation Request** to get started.


Your privacy is important to us. You can find out more information on how we handle your data for recruiting purposes in our Privacy Policy for Recruitment.

jobs.description:
Account Manager

Job Overview  
We are seeking a dedicated and proactive Account Manager to serve as the primary point of contact for our existing clients. In this role, you will manage day\-to\-day account relationships, ensure customer satisfaction, and support continued account health through effective communication and attentive service. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and the ability to build lasting professional relationships.

Responsibilities

* Build strong client relationships with existing accounts to ensure repeat business
* Serve as the primary point of contact for existing clients, understanding their needs and making sure they're met
* Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, across email, phone, live chat, and other messaging channels
* Resolve account problems and address customer concerns and suggestions
* Manage day\-to\-day account activity, including order entry and coordinating with the fulfillment team for accurate, on\-time delivery

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------



Fujifilm’s Data Storage Solutions division provides magnetic storage tape to customers around the world, supporting mission critical data retention needs across a wide range of industries. Magnetic tape is recognized as a core component of modern data center infrastructure, valued for its reliability, cost efficiency, and low power consumption in large scale and long\-term data archival.


As AI workloads drive data volumes to grow at an unprecedented pace, demand for Fujifilm’s magnetic tape is expanding rapidly. To further accelerate this growth and strengthen our engagement with key hyperscale customers, we are adding an experienced Account Manager to our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing revenue, building and maintaining long term relationships, and serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing, supply chain, engineering, and related functions within major hyperscale accounts.


**This position is remote and based on the West Coast.**


**Company Overview**
--------------------


"
At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission\-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one\-time\-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.  



  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.  



  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers


"
**Job Description**
-------------------



**Responsibilities**

  

* Manage and deepen relationships with existing hyperscale customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and trust.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities within key accounts, leading end‑to‑end proposal and leveraging the growing demand for tape‑based storage.
* Develop and implement account strategies to achieve revenue targets and increase FUJIFILM’s share of business within each account.
* Engage with multiple stakeholders at customer organizations (e.g., purchasing, engineering, SCM) and maintain strong relationships at various organizational levels.
* Strengthen relationships with system integration partners and establish a seamless co\-operation for hyperscale customers
* Collaborate closely with internal technical, supply chain, and operations support teams, as well as Tokyo headquarters, to align sales activities and to ensure effective coordination between customer requests and internal operations
* Prepare and maintain accurate sales forecasts and provide input to internal stakeholders to support production scheduling and inventory planning.
* Review and negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and conditions in cooperation with internal stakeholders, including legal, finance, and operations.
* Monitor market trends in storage, data centers, and hyperscale ecosystems, and provide structured feedback to internal teams to support product and business planning.

**Required Skills/Education**

  

* Minimum of 10 years of account management experience, preferably in the IT industry.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large‑scale, strategic enterprise customers.
* Experience in selling IT‑related products (software and/or hardware).
* Strong relationship‑building, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment and to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional and cross‑cultural teams.

**Desired Skills**

  

* Knowledge of storage, cloud, or data center industries.
* Direct sales or account management experience with hyperscale customers (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or other large‑scale cloud service providers).
* Experience in selling storage hardware such as SSDs and HDDs, and/or other data‑center‑grade storage systems.
* Experience working in a global organization and coordinating with overseas headquarters (e.g., Tokyo).
* Willingness to travel to customer sites approximately once per month within North America.
* Occasional international travel to Japan to accompany key customers and to coordinate with Tokyo headquarters

**Salary and Benefits**  

* Salary: $120,000 plus bonus depending on experience.
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life Insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Growth Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the team**
------------------


The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data\-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company's growth and success.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


Reporting to the Director, Global Growth Content, you will own and scale Airwallex’s growth and demand generation content engine globally on the payments product. You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.


This role is ideal for a hands\-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one\-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion\-oriented content.


You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion.


This role is based in San Francisco.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high\-performing team over time.
* Own the end\-to\-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid\-funnel conversion content, and product\-led narratives.
* Write, edit, and ship high\-impact content including:


	+ SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content
	+ Ebooks, whitepapers, and long\-form guides
	+ One\-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers
* Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable.
* Use user, customer, and market insights to improve ICP targeting, segmentation, messaging, and content distribution strategies.
* Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals.
* Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact.
* Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts.
* Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t.
* Balance short\-term growth outcomes with longer\-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand.

**Who you are**
===============


We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.


**Minimum qualifications:**
---------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in growth content marketing, demand gen content, or SEO\-led content roles, preferably at a high\-growth B2B technology company.
* A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline.
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly.
* Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on\-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering.
* A data\-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze content performance and optimize based on results—not just instincts.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance, and Lifecycle teams.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, global environment and communicating progress

jobs.title: Urology Specialty Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Urology Specialty Representative is accountable appropriate product adoption across targeted Urology accounts, including large urology group practices, hospital\-affiliated urology practices, and other high\-potential specialty accounts to drive sales.


This role engages Urologists, APPs, practice administrators, clinical staff, and other key office stakeholders to support patient identification, treatment selection, practice workflow, and appropriate product utilization among eligible patients within the approved indication. The Urology Specialty Representative will meet and/or exceed sales performance objectives in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customer targets within assigned accounts.


The role will require:

* Providing scientific and clinical information within the disease state area and approved product
* Delivering clinically brand sales presentations of approved products to physicians, APPs, medical staff, and other appropriate clinic personnel by utilizing customer engagement selling model
* Effectively utilize and manage all resources to optimize customer engagement
* Collaborate effectively across a highly matrixed sales organization, partnering closely with Organized Provider Account Directors, Reimbursement Managers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to drive aligned execution and business success.
* Participation in training and development programs while abiding by all industry and corporate policies and procedures


Successful outcome is driving sales in an account setting by convincing HCPs to write prescriptions for indication patients.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Achieve and exceed sales targets within the assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated business plan to maximize sales and prioritize high\-value customers and growth opportunities.
* Translate formulary wins and market access achievements into consistent prescribing and utilization within targeted accounts
* Educate customers on patient eligibility, treatment selection, and the clinical rationale supporting the hospital\-avoidance value proposition.
* Identify and address clinical, operational, behavioral, and process\-related barriers impacting product adoption
* Plan and organize activities to achieve call metrics, optimizing coverage and frequency to key customers to maximize access and sales opportunities.
* Develop in\-depth product and account knowledge, staying informed about local and regional market trends.
* Analyze utilization trends, customer insights, and local market dynamics to identify opportunities and drive performance.
* Conduct educational programs, in\-services, speaker programs, and compliant scientific discussions.
* Collaborate with peers in the sales organization to share best practices and strategies.
* Provide feedback on marketing strategy, analyze the effectiveness of sales activities and territory performance, and develop territory plans with the Regional Sales Director, brand team, and other support partners to deliver exceptional customer experience.
* Manage the territory budget to support sales and marketing activities effectively.
* Complete administrative tasks promptly, executing the company brand strategy and tactics within the assigned geographic area.
* Participate in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate and industry policies and procedures.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BA/BS degree from an accredited institution
* 4\+ years of demonstrated experience and proven sales success in pharmaceutical/medical/biotech industry
* 2\+ years demonstrated large practice group account management experience
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, including overnight travel
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds
* Valid driver's license

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Consistent record of top\-tier sales performance and proven product launch success
* Demonstrated success driving demand generation within large group accounts
* Urology sales experience strongly preferred
* Anti\-Infective experience preferred
* Expertise in account selling and managing complex sales processes.
* Deep knowledge of group practice business model, organizational structure, and key stakeholder roles
* Strong understanding of group practice account decision\-making processes, clinical pathways, formulary management, and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
* Experience collaborating across community and hospital care settings
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
* Analyze data and trends to create actionable business plans
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing market conditions
* Demonstrated ability to adhere to all regulatory, legal, and compliance standards.
* Exceptional presentation and selling skills, coupled with strong business acumen.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $160,000 to $170,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

The Program Specialist, Alumni Affairs supports the planning and execution of programs, communications, and events that keep alumni of the Stephen M. Kellen Term Member Program and International Affairs Fellowship Program engaged with the institution and one another. Working within a small, collaborative team, the program specialist handles day\-to\-day operations, database management, event logistics, and member communications that strengthen CFR's alumni community over time.

**Education and** **Experience**

**Related Skills \& Other Requirements**
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with a CRM or membership database (e.g., Salesforce, iMIS, or similar) is required

----------------------------------



Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.

-----------------------------

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is committed to fostering a foreign policy community in the United States that is more representative of American society, recognizing that diverse backgrounds and perspectives contribute to broader, more informed participation in the foreign policy debate and lead to an enhanced understanding of the world and the United States’ role therein. ==================================================================


* Posted Date: Sep 25, 2026 Deadline: Oct 9, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. * Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.

### **Description**


At MMGY Global, we believe nothing shapes your view of the world like travel. So every day, we share our clients’ stories from a perspective that inspires people to see the world differently. Our personalized service and strategy connect media, consumers and influencers across the globe, taking people to new places and changing their views for the better. At MMGY, we inspire people to go places.  

We have an immediate opening for an **Account Coordinator** in our **New York** office.  

The Account Coordinator plays a key role in supporting public relations initiatives and campaigns across a wide range of international and domestic travel clients (hotels, tourism boards, etc.). This position will focus primarily on public relations activities for our clients and will also provide the successful candidate exposure to a broad range of marketing and communications tactics in the exciting world of international travel. Primary duties for the Account Coordinator role include:**Primary Duties may include:*** Working alongside our talented PR teams supporting on 4\-6 client accounts at a given time
* You'll be identifying trending stories, developing engaging media pitches, building targeted media lists to help our clients reach new audiences and captivate current ones
* You'll have the opportunity to work with a variety of international and domestic travel clients, and work closely with our team to bring ideas to life
* Ongoing proactive and reactive media pitching to earn stories about client news and brand initiatives
* Researching key media contacts to pitch
* Contribute to all reports, including weekly client updates, meeting agendas / recaps, monthly reporting, etc
* Clipping client press/influencer hits daily and regularly updating press trackers
* Gathering intel on relevant trends, story identification and industry insights
* Media event assistance, as needed
* Other misc requirements as required by team structure and client needs
* This role may include some travel, must be able to travel and meet all domestic and international travel requirements

**Required Skills:**
To fulfill your duties, your skills must include:* Minimum of an undergraduate degree (Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts) in communications, journalism, or related field
* 1\+ years PR/job\-related experience in public relations, communications, marketing, journalism or related fields, with direct travel and lifestyle client background preferred
* Strong detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects/tasks at any given time to ensure continued progress across agency work
* Clear, concise communicator, internally, with clients and outside partners
* Excellent writing skills, both technical and creative
* Strong news writing and reporting proficiency
* Demonstrable media pitching skills
* Solid understanding of social media and how to utilize it
* Have and inspire a sense of urgency among other agency channels whenever necessary
* Ability to anticipate needs and learn quickly
* Sensitive listening skills (from client, supervisor, and media)
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Computer proficiency and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google programs; Muck Rack and other PR programs a bonus


Salary for this position: $48,000


MMGY Global provides a comprehensive PTO \+ benefits package that includes a hybrid telework policy. Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa. MMGY Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  

Who Are We? We’re a travel\-obsessed collective of more than 600 people across the country and around the globe. And when we say we inspire people to go places, we mean ALL people. That’s why we’re focused on nurturing a workforce that is representative of the places we visit.

**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.


**About the Role**
==================


Emerging Talent is an important part of how Ramp builds for the long term. It gives us the opportunity to meet exceptional people early, build relationships before they enter the broader talent market, and develop the next generation of Ramp talent.


We’re hiring an Emerging Talent Operations Associate to help run the operational foundation behind our internship and new\-grad programs. You’ll partner with recruiters, coordinators, hiring managers, People Ops, and IT to keep candidate data, interviews, offers, onboarding, and intern support moving smoothly.


You’ll help create an exceptional experience from a candidate’s first interaction with Ramp through offer and, for interns, potential conversion to full\-time. This is a hands\-on role for someone organized and resourceful who enjoys making complex programs feel seamless. As you learn the work, you’ll help improve processes, templates, and simple automations.


**This is a temporary, full\-time role with strong potential to convert to a permanent full\-time position.**


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Support daily operations across the internship and new\-grad recruiting lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate candidate, event, and program data in Ashby.
* Partner with recruiting coordinators on candidate communications during high\-volume periods.
* Support job and offer administration, including requisitions, approvals, and documentation.
* Help coordinate onboarding, access, housing, and other intern and new\-hire needs.
* Track recurring work, flag risks early, and keep important details from slipping.
* Improve team templates, checklists, and operating processes.
* Identify repetitive work that could be simplified with AI or practical automation.
* During slower operational periods, support program management.

**What You Need**
-----------------


* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent or program operations, university recruiting, events, or another detail\-heavy service role. Equivalent experience is welcome.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Clear, warm communication, timely updates, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort managing shifting priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Curiosity about learning new tools and improving how work gets done.
* Good judgment, ownership, and a habit of raising issues early.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Ashby, Greenhouse, or another applicant\-tracking system.
* Familiarity working with Talent, People Ops, IT, Workplace, or Payroll.
* Experience improving a process, tracker, template, or workflow.

jobs.title: Start-up / Field Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Extend is building document processing infrastructure for the most technical AI teams to work with unstructured data (e.g. PDFs, Excel, images, etc.). AI teams at companies like Square, Zillow, Brex, Flatiron Health, Checkr, and Mercury use Extend to process their most complex documents.


We're looking for a Start\-up / Field Marketing Lead at Extend. You will own the mandate of field and conference marketing, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who makes sure every startup and developer knows Extend and thinks of us because of the events and physical presence we build. Awareness takes a long time to turn into a signup or a booked demo, and being IRL, month after month, is how we'll drive it.


We care far more about slope than years of experience. We're looking for someone who can project\-manage the hell out of an event, stays unflappable when things break, and genuinely loves planning IRL events and being part of the startup community.

**Why you should consider joining**
-----------------------------------

* We've grown revenue 6x YoY with our growth continuing to accelerate (8 figures, 200%\+ NRR)
* We have a product loved by users and being used in mission\-critical flows at enterprises (Square, Zillow, Chime) and startups (Brex, Mercury, Checkr), and many more
* The market for document processing has expanded 1000x due to LLMs, and all existing solutions are low NPS
* We're punching well above our weight, supporting customer and revenue metrics with half the team size of other startups — everyone joining at this stage will have outsized impact
* We've raised our Series A, de\-risked the business, and our sales team has exceeded quota every quarter, but there's still tremendous upside ahead; now's the perfect time to join
* You'll be joining a talent dense team, operating in a high performance culture, in\-person in NYC, with high equity ownership
* You'll get a front row seat to how a successful startup is built, with plenty of leadership opportunities as we grow quickly

**Role and Impact**
-------------------

* **Expand Extend’s field footprint and brand awareness** in SF and NYC via creative, fun, and well\-curated events in both locations. Think bold.
* **Activate the startup community:** YC and Demo Day events, co\-hosted events with partners, founder dinners — whatever makes every startup know and think of Extend
* **Support conference execution:** project\-manage Extend's conference presence end to end — booth build, shipping logistics, staffing, run\-of\-show, and follow\-up — so the team shows up ready and nothing gets figured out on the day
* **Make people stop:** design booths and activations that get people to stop, engage, and remember us — tasteful, never generic B2B
* **Make events bigger than the room:** produce for social so an event reaches people who weren't there
* **Tie IRL to pipeline:** connect events to signups and booked meetings so we know what's working and where to double down

**Ideal Candidate Credentials**
-------------------------------

* 1\+ years of experience. We're hiring for slope, not years. Great backgrounds include VC (platform, chief of staff, or community), event or field marketing, production, SDR or growth roles with a lot of event work, and chief of staff roles
* You love planning IRL events, not just attending them, and you're already part of the startup community: you're on X, you know founders, and you have strong opinions about what makes a good event
* You break an event into workstreams, keep every stakeholder on track, and see the blind spots before they show up
* You're warm, extroverted, and not afraid of rejection: you'll say good morning to every person who walks past the booth, and a "no thank you" doesn't slow you down
* You bring creative, unconventional ideas that cut through the noise at events where everyone else looks the same
* Experience managing the conference lifecycle: event selection, sponsorships, booth or activation strategy, speaking opportunities, meeting generation, onsite logistics, and post\-event pipeline follow\-up.
* Based in NYC and willing to travel to SF often

**Benefits**
------------


Beyond the below, we care deeply about each of our candidates on a personal level. We take the time to understand your needs to craft a package designed for you:

* Insurance — 100% health insurance premium coverage
* Relocation — for candidates based outside of NYC
* Unlimited PTO policy — we trust everyone like owners, take what you need
* Daily lunch \& snacks covered (plus dinner if you're in the office late) — you'll never go hungry and you help pick the snacks
* Unlimited token / tooling access — no handicaps on your productivity
* Learning and development investment — we invest heavily in our team and support your growth

As a Wholesale Account Coordinator, you will be at the center of one of Levi's most important wholesale partnerships, helping bring products, strategies, and seasonal launches to life for the Macy's business. Working alongside Account Managers and cross\-functional partners, you'll drive order execution, support product launches, analyze business performance, and help solve challenges that impact the customer experience. You'll gain broad exposure across the wholesale business while contributing to a high\-profile account and learning from a collaborative team and manager committed to mentorship and development.

 **About the Job**

* **Sales Support:** Partner with the Account Managers and sales team to execute account strategies, support seasonal business initiatives, and contribute to achieving sales and growth objectives.
* **Day\-to\-Day Account Management:** Maintain account documentation, manage item setup processes, support credit memo and claim resolution, and assist with key account activities including sell\-ins, business reviews, and go\-to\-market planning.
* **Order Management:** Manage order entry, planned unit maintenance, and purchase order tracking from placement through fulfillment. Partner with internal teams and retail customers to resolve order, inventory, delivery, and credit\-related issues while supporting on\-time and accurate product delivery.
* **Sample \& Product Management:** Own the end\-to\-end coordination of seasonal and in\-season samples, including ordering, tracking, inventory management, showroom readiness, and internal and external distribution.
* **Sales Analysis \& Reporting:** Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, quarterly, and seasonal sales, shipping, and performance reports. Analyze business trends and provide insights that support account planning.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with Planning, Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to support account objectives, resolve issues, and drive business execution.
* **Market \& Retail Insights:** Monitor retail trends, competitive activity, pricing, product placement, and in\-store execution to support account planning and identify opportunities within the marketplace.

 **About You**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3\+ years of experience in wholesale, retail, merchandising, sales support, sales operations, customer operations, or a related consumer products environment.
* **Order \& Business Operations:** Experience supporting order management, purchase order processes, inventory coordination, account operations, or related business processes.

This is a hybrid work schedule based in our New York, New York office. You will be expected in office 3 days per week typically Tuesday\-Thursday. Note, time in office can vary depending on business needs.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Skyline**
-----------------


Skyline is Citi’s U.S. internal creative agency — a full\-service partner offering Strategy, Creative, Data \& Insights, AI, and Operations capabilities to business partners across the firm. Skyline's purpose is to help Citi's businesses communicate more effectively, reach their audiences, and demonstrate measurable impact. As Skyline evolves, the Account Management function is expanding its remit: moving upstream from campaign execution to strategic partnership, and from project facilitation to proactive internal intelligence and opportunity development.


**Role Purpose**
----------------


The Strategic Account Manager builds strong, proactive partnerships between Skyline and its internal marketing partners by developing a deep understanding of marketing partners business priorities, translating those priorities into creative and strategic opportunities, and connecting marketing partners with the right Skyline capabilities across Creative, Data \& Insights, and Operations. This role serves as the strategic bridge between the marketing partners and Skyline — helping the agency move upstream from receiving requests to identifying needs, shaping solutions, and demonstrating the value Skyline delivers across the account.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Internal Client Partnership \& Intelligence**


* Build and maintain trusted stakeholder relationships across assigned internal business partners, engaging beyond individual projects to develop a holistic understanding of the marketing partners’ business
* Develop deep knowledge of the internal client's objectives, upcoming priorities, audience needs, decision\-making environment, and organizational dynamics
* Capture and document relevant partner signals, recurring needs, challenges, and emerging priorities to maintain a consolidated, living view of the account
* Bring internal client intelligence back into Skyline to inform planning, capability development, and proactive outreach

### **Opportunity Development**


* Identify opportunities where Skyline can become involved earlier in the marketing partners planning cycle or provide broader, more integrated support
* Maintain the account Opportunity Tracker, capturing outreach activity, potential work, expected business impact, and next actions
* Connect opportunities across teams, products, and lines of business where appropriate
* Partner with Strategy, Creative and Data \& Insights to develop proactive recommendations
* Support the appropriate growth of the account relationship and help reduce unnecessary reliance on external agencies

### **Strategic Intake \& Solution Shaping**


* Lead intake conversations that help marketing partners clarify the business problem before work moves into execution
* Determine whether a request requires a single deliverable, a broader campaign, research, data support, or a different Skyline solution
* Bring the right Skyline experts into the conversation early to shape the response
* Improve brief quality by ensuring objectives, audience, desired outcomes, context, and measures of success are clearly defined before handoff to delivery teams
* Constructively challenge or redirect requests when a different approach would create greater value for our marketing partners

### **Account Planning \& Governance**


* Maintain a structured account plan covering internal client priorities, stakeholders, active and future work, relationship health, risks, and opportunities
* Lead strategic account reviews focused on intelligence, decisions, opportunities, and risks — distinct from project status updates
* Coordinate with Operations on capacity implications, prioritization, and portfolio\-level visibility
* Escalate account\-level risks proactively, before they affect the relationship or delivery quality
* Contribute account insights to the broader Internal Client Intelligence Hub and to Skyline leadership reporting

### **Value \& Impact Storytelling**


* Partner with Data \& Insights and Operations to capture and communicate evidence of Skyline's business impact
* Connect completed work to measurable business outcomes — including internal client satisfaction, efficiency gains, cost savings, and increased internal adoption
* Help identify potential case studies, proof points, and leadership narratives that demonstrate Skyline's strategic value
* Use account insights and performance information to recommend next steps and future opportunities
* Help marketing partners understand the full value of Skyline's capabilities beyond the individual deliverable

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
-----------------------------------


* Skyline is involved earlier in internal client planning cycles — not only at the point of an execution request
* More opportunities are proactively identified and converted into work, tracked through the Opportunity Tracker
* Marketing partners engage with more Skyline capabilities — not just Creative — reflecting deeper strategic integration
* Strategic account reviews produce decisions and actions, not status updates
* Skyline can demonstrate measurable business value and internal client impact beyond campaign delivery metrics
* Internal client satisfaction and internal adoption improve across assigned accounts
* Account risks and opportunities are visible and addressed at the leadership level before they become issues
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance w

Nextdoor Account Managers are a diverse, driven, and strategic group of client services and salespeople focused on connecting brands with our community of neighbors through our growing portfolio of advertising products. The team culture mirrors the larger business focus, relying on building trusted relationships both internally as well as with our partners. The team drives results for our brand partners while creating neighbor value. We're a purpose\-driven company and we're recruiting like\-minded client services professionals who are as passionate about customer value as they are professional growth, and building a culture of belonging.



At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs.



We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. You'll work with brands and agencies to execute buys on the platform, while also partnering with product management and engineering teams to provide feedback and identify opportunities to improve the efficacy of our product. You'll bring a passion for driving customer value and business outcomes, with a track record of retaining and growing customer relationships.

* Build and manage strong partnerships with brand and agency partners; own day\-to\-day communication to ensure campaign success
* Provide excellent customer service by proactively monitoring campaign delivery and performance, and solving campaign\-related issues in a timely manner
* Own data\-driven upsell and renewal conversations to retain and grow advertising partnerships
* Leverage internal tools and dashboards to analyze and optimize performance
* Be a platform expert; cultivate a strategic approach to product adoption through deep knowledge of your customer's business challenges and our platform's solutions
* Create and present strategic POVs, campaign wrap\-ups and/or Quarterly Business Reviews to clients
* Work cross\-functionally to ensure all aspects of a campaign are executed flawlessly
* Participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises
* Build in\-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor's company culture

#### **What You'll Bring To The Team**


* 2\-5 years of experience in account management or client services at a digital media/advertising company or agency
* Strong understanding of campaign strategy, execution, and optimization within a platform\-based media buying environment with both, managed and self\-service clients
* Track record of successfully retaining and growing customer relationships
* Hands\-on experience optimizing brand awareness and lower\-funnel performance KPIs
* Curiosity, hunger to learn, and passion for problem\-solving
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and high\-volume environment; manage multiple projects while maintaining strong attention to detail
* Data\-driven and analytical mindset; deliver actionable insights to drive strategy and renewals
* A passion for community building, to inspire a more inclusive team and diversity of thought, both at Nextdoor and in your own neighborhoods
* Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done

#### **Rewards**



Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.



The compensation range for this role includes a base salary \+ commission structure with a 70/30 split. Commission will vary depending on your achievement of sales\-related goals and objectives. The budgeted OTE **inclusive of base \+ commission** is in the range of $110,000 \- $135,000 (base salary of $77,000 \- $94,500\) on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location.



We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Build Your Market. Own Your Success.**


*Help us shape the future of plant\-powered wellness.*

  

Vivazen creates plant\-powered products featuring kratom and kava for consumers seeking effective alternatives. Our products are already available in more than 70,000 retail locations nationwide and we are just getting started!

  

We are expanding into new markets, opening new retail channels, and developing new product categories. To accelerate that growth, we are looking for ambitious people who want more than an ordinary job. Vivazen is a small, fast\-moving company where strong performers are trusted, ideas can quickly become action, and individual contributions make a visible difference. If you are energized by growth, motivated by results, and excited by the opportunity to help build what comes next, we would like to meet you.

 **Independent Sales Opportunities**


*Your territory. Your relationships. Your upside.*

  

We are looking for entrepreneurial 1099 sales professionals who know how to open doors, build lasting customer relationships, and turn opportunity into revenue.

  

This is an opportunity for self\-directed salespeople who value independence and want their earning potential to reflect the results they create. You will represent an established brand with significant national retail distribution while helping Vivazen expand into new accounts, channels, and territories.

  

You will have the freedom to develop your market, manage your relationships, and build a meaningful book of business with support from a company that moves quickly and wants its sales partners to win.

 **Why Sell Vivazen?**


*An Established Brand with Room to Grow*

  

Vivazen products can already be found in more than 70,000 retailers across the country. You are not starting with an unknown concept, you are building from an established foundation with substantial growth potential.

 **Performance\-Based Earning Potential**



We believe results should be rewarded. Our independent sales opportunities are designed for motivated producers who want to increase their income by expanding distribution, developing accounts, and driving sales.

 **Freedom to Build**



Take ownership of your territory and determine how you create momentum. We value initiative, resourcefulness, and sales professionals who know their customers and markets.

 **Products with a Compelling Consumer Story**



Represent plant\-powered products in a rapidly evolving wellness category and help retailers respond to growing consumer interest in alternative solutions.

 **Speed and Access**



We are not weighed down by layers of bureaucracy. You will work with a responsive, entrepreneurial organization that can recognize opportunities and act quickly.

 **The Chance to Make an Impact**



At Vivazen, your work will be visible. The relationships you create and the markets you develop will directly contribute to the company’s next stage of growth.

 **You May Be a Great Fit If You Are:**

  

* A proven hunter who enjoys opening new accounts and building a territory
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, and comfortable working independently
* Driven by achievement and energized by performance\-based compensation
* Skilled at developing strong, long\-term retailer and distributor relationships
* Persistent, credible, and confident presenting products to decision\-makers
* Organized and disciplined about pipelines, follow\-up, and account development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving and evolving business
* Knowledgeable about convenience, smoke and vape, specialty retail, grocery, wellness, or related consumer\-product channels
* Committed to responsible selling and operating within all applicable regulatory and brand guidelines

  


**What Success Looks Like**



You identify untapped opportunities, consistently open qualified accounts, and grow productive relationships over time. You understand that great sales performance is not simply about closing an initial order, it is about earning trust, supporting sell\-through, creating repeat business, and building a territory with lasting value.

  

You bring market intelligence back to the business, helping us understand what customers want, where opportunities are emerging, and how Vivazen can continue improving.

  

Most importantly, you take ownership. You do not wait to be managed, you create momentum!

 **More Ways to Grow With Vivazen**



Sales is central to our expansion, but growth requires exceptional people across the business. We also seek talented professionals in operations, marketing, and other commercial functions who are ready to solve problems, improve how we work, and help us enter new categories.

  

Whether you build customer relationships, strengthen our operating capabilities, or bring our brand to life, you will be joining a company where your contribution matters.

 **Ready to Build Something Bigger?**



If you want the freedom to perform, the opportunity to shape a growing market, and a company that recognizes people who deliver, explore our current opportunities.

 **Bring your ambition. Build your market. Grow with Vivazen.**

  



Independent sales roles are 1099 contractor opportunities. Compensation, territory availability, responsibilities, and eligibility requirements vary by position and will be detailed during the selection process.

 **Learn more about us here:** https://vivazen.com/

Join Planhat's Deployment Strategy (our way of saying Customer Success!) team. Help build the systems our Deployment Strategists run on, support them on the accounts that matter most, and grow into the role yourself.


**Competencies**
----------------


Planhat's Deployment Strategy group is scaling, and this role exists to help it scale well.


This is a supporting role, and it sits at the center of the team. Your primary job is supporting the Director in building the structure that makes our Deployment Strategists effective: planning frameworks, renewal standards, portfolio reporting, account intelligence, and whatever else the group needs as it grows. Alongside that, you support the Deployment Strategists on key accounts. You will not own the structure and you will not own the accounts. You will make both better, and you will learn more in two years than most people do in five. You will not be handed a portfolio on day one. You will earn one.


Experience matters less than drive, ambition, judgment, how fast you learn, and whether you fit how this team works. Most people who succeed here are recent graduates with a record of performing somewhere competitive, or have one to two years in a startup, consultancy or fast\-growth SaaS environment.


* **Structured thinker.** You take an ambiguous situation, break it into parts, and come back with a recommendation rather than a list of questions.
* **Comfortable with data.** A CRM data model, a field mapping or a large spreadsheet doesn't intimidate you. You can tell when customer data is wrong.
* **Disciplined.** You close your commitments without being chased. It is the strongest predictor of success in this role.
* **Credible in writing.** You can write a clear paragraph to a VP. Plain, direct, no filler.
* **Quick learner.** Planhat is a deep product and there are no passengers here, only crew.
* **Self\-directed.** You take initiative without waiting for direction and do well with autonomy and accountability.
* **Ambitious.** You want a career in customer strategy, not a first job.

  

**Trajectory**
--------------


This is the entry point into Deployment Strategy at Planhat, with the objective of transitioning into a full Deployment Strategist role owning a named portfolio.


* **Within days:** product training, account history and internal reviews. Your first weeks are internal.
* **Within the first few months:** you are in the room for executive customer conversations, renewal planning and escalations on accounts most people don't touch until well into their careers. You are there to absorb, not to carry the conversation. The Deployment Strategist owns the relationship and the outcome.
* **Supporting the Director:** you help run the operating rhythm of the Americas team, contribute to the frameworks it runs on, turn portfolio data into something leadership can act on, and pick up the projects that keep getting deprioritized because everyone else is in accounts. The Director sets the direction. You do a lot of the building.
* **Supporting a DS, day to day:** preparing the ground for a renewal with the owning DS, updating account plans and stakeholder maps after a call, pulling together EBR and QBR content that holds up in front of a C\-level audience, and tracking commitments to closure. The DS carries the account. You make sure they walk in prepared.
* **Learning the product:** real fluency in Planhat, built on live customer environments rather than a sandbox, while shadowing every Deployment Strategist on the team.
* **Longer term:** progressively more account\-facing responsibility, then transition to a Deployment Strategist with your own portfolio.

Progression is earned on performance, not tenure.

  

  

**Definition of Success**
-------------------------


* Planhat certified and independently productive in the platform by day 90\.
* Our operating rhythm measurably improves, and the improvement is attributable in part to what you helped build and refine.
* Deployment Strategists trust you inside their live customer environments without checking your work.
* Renewal preparation you contribute to is complete and review\-ready ahead of the 90 day mark, consistently, and the owning DS never has to redo it.
* Deployment Strategists across the team ask for you by name on their hardest accounts.

  

**Compensation**
----------------


The salary range for this position is $50,000 to $60,000 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience and performance. The range listed is one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
