new_jobs.title: Sales Operations & Business Development Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator (Travel/Remote)** **Sullivan on Comp** is a subscription\-based legal research and technology platform serving the California workers’ compensation industry. The sales team is also expanding its business\-development efforts for Cadence, an AI platform used by law firms and claims organizations to review and analyze workers’ compensation matters.  

Sullivan on Comp is seeking a proactive, highly organized **Sales Operations \& Business Development Coordinator** to provide direct support to the Account Executive responsible for new\-business development. The primary focus of this role is to support revenue\-generating sales activity. Pipeline prioritization, prospect follow\-up, trial engagement, re\-engagement, and business\-development support will take precedence over routine CRM cleanup and administrative tasks when priorities compete.  

This position combines HubSpot and pipeline management with prospect research, trial engagement, outbound follow\-up, sales campaigns, and business\-development support.
The successful candidate will help ensure that promising opportunities receive consistent attention, stale opportunities are identified and appropriately re\-engaged, and the Account Executive can spend more time on substantive sales conversations, demonstrations, relationship development, and closing. **Compensation:**  

* $32 – $38/hour ($66,560 – $79,040 annually)
* Annual performance incentive of 5% target / 7\.5% maximum
 **Travel \& Work Location**  

* Candidate must reside in CA.
* This position can be performed primarily in a remote environment, with up to 15% \- 25% travel.
* Travel may include but is not limited to 2\-3 meetings in SoCal Office, approximately 10 industry conferences or trade shows each lasting 2\-4 days, and additional occasional business travel on an as\-needed basis.

 **Daily Objectives**  

* Manage and prioritize the HubSpot sales pipeline, ensuring accurate deal, activity, forecast, and next\-step data while identifying high\-priority opportunities for Account Executive focus.
* Monitor active trials and prospect engagement, conduct outreach via phone and email, gather feedback, and schedule demonstrations, training sessions, and follow\-up meetings.
* Research target organizations, decision\-makers, and market opportunities within the California workers’ compensation industry using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other business intelligence tools.
* Re\-engage dormant leads, inactive opportunities, former customers, and trial users through targeted email, phone, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Support outbound business development efforts by booking qualified meetings and advancing prospects toward substantive sales conversations.
* Assist with HubSpot sequences, workflows, lead segmentation, webinars, re\-engagement initiatives, and targeted marketing campaigns while monitoring campaign performance.
* Leverage sales intelligence and CRM data to identify follow\-up priorities, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to improve pipeline progression.
* Maintain detailed records of sales activities, prepare meeting briefings, track follow\-up commitments, coordinate proposals, and support accurate forecasting and reporting.
* Collaborate with Account Management, Marketing, Customer Service, and other internal teams to support customer acquisition and revenue growth initiatives.
* Support industry conferences, trade shows, and firm events through planning, on\-site participation, lead capture, post\-event follow\-up, and business travel as needed.
 **Skills \& Experience**  

* 2\+ years of experience in sales and/or business development in the Workers’ Compensation, Insurance, Legal Tech, SAAS, or similar Legal Services industry.
* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM.
* Experience providing client activation and renewal support to account management, sales, or customer success teams.
* Strong organizational skills, highly detail\-oriented, excellent time management, and holding strong follow\-through abilities.
* Strong multi\-tasking abilities, ability to work independently, and proactively work as part of a team.
* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, databases, and sales systems.
* Strong customer service and ability to communicate professionally on the phone and via email.
* Exercise good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated.
* Be willing and able to travel for conferences, trade shows, and firm meetings.

 **Health \& Wellness**  

* Medical plan options including **Kaiser Permanente** HMO, **Cigna** EPO, and **Cigna** PPO
* Dental coverage through **Delta Dental** with DHMO and PPO options
* **Vision** coverage through VSP
* Firm\-Paid **Life/AD\&D** (up to $150k) \& Long\-term Disability (**LTD**) Insurance.
* Firm\-Paid Employee Assistance Program (**EAP**) offering confidential support.
 **Retirement \& Voluntary Benefits*** **401(k)** retirement plan with employer contribution.
* **Critical Illness**, **Accident**, and **Hospital Indemnity Coverage**, available at group rates.
* Flexible Spending Account (**FSA**) and Dependent Care Assistance Program (**DCAP**) options for eligible pre\-tax expenses.
* Voluntary short\-term disability (**STD**) coverage.
* Supplemental **Life and AD\&D Insurance**.
* Optional **Pet Insurance**, because family comes in many forms.

The ideal candidate will develop and maintain positive relationships within assigned customer accounts, overseeing the sales process, and acting as the primary point of contact to retain and grow these accounts. * Demonstrated sales skills in prospecting, qualifying, proposing and closing sales and capable of developing and managing large accounts (existing and new)

* Frequent travel to job sites within assigned region

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II : Research Cancer
new_jobs.description:
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**Reporting to the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, or Director of Clinical Research Operations, the Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC\-II) is responsible for all aspects of clinical research activities and works in close cooperation with study physicians, inter\- and intradepartmental stakeholders, and sponsors. The CRC\-II provides study management, support, and coordination for FDA regulated research industry\-sponsored, government funded, and/or investigator initiated clinical research trials. This may include blood collection, data and trials that have therapeutic or device component. The CRC\-II ensures smooth, accurate process of clinical studies from the planning, implementation, and post\-study closure procedures.


The CRC\-II is involved in all aspects of the clinical research process included, but no limited to protocol review, preparation and administration of the informed consent, development of study treatment plans, completion of study related visit forms, ensuring protocol required assessments are completed per study guidelines, processing of lab samples per IATA standards, and regular communication with study sponsors and their collaborators.


He/she will ensure accurate completion of case report forms (CRFs), adverse event/serious adverse event (SAE) reporting and scheduled subject follow\-up visits. Discusses research study with potential study subjects and answers any questions (may refer questions to Principal Investigator or Sub\-Investigator when appropriate) while obtaining informed consent.


Responsible for development of study flow sheets, prepare study source documentation, gather study data, and assess subject for study eligibility (inclusion/exclusion). In addition, the CRC\-II will record protocol specific assessments and treatments, ensure collection and shipment of samples, complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies, collect, enters and clean data into study database while maintaining data quality. I. He/she will host study team meetings, attend site initiation visits (SIVs) and perform other duties as assigned.


Must be knowledgeable of Good Clinical Practices, protection of human subjects in research practices, and FDA regulatory guidelines regarding clinical research.


  
**Education and Experience*** High School Diploma with 2\-3 years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team.
* Attention to details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Medical terminology required. Working knowledge of FDA, NIH and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines.
* Understanding of clinical trial methodologies and experience filing Institutional Review Board documents.
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases.
* International Air Transport Association (IATA) Certification
* Current ACRP or SoCRA Certification.

**License Required:**N/A


**License Preferred:**N/A


**Certifications Required**N/A


**Certifications Preferred**May only perform blood draws by meeting and maintaining State of California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) Certification

Sales Department

===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**

* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed




**Position Requirements**


* BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Netsuite/ERP, Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

**Overview**


The Account Manager (AM) is a developmental sales\-focused role tasked with supporting day\-to\-day revenue efforts while developing the skills and experience needed to become a future Account Executive. This role touches all facets of the sales process—from proposal development and client support to campaign execution and stewardship—while partnering closely with Account Executives and internal teams. This is a position designed for high\-potential candidates who want to learn the business, build selling skills, and grow into a full\-cycle seller with direct ownership of accounts and revenue.

  

**Responsibilities**


* Partner closely with Account Executives to support active accounts, proposals, and revenue opportunities
* Assist in selling streaming campaigns, with the opportunity to include linear inventory for cross\-platform packages
* Participate in sales calls (virtual and in\-person) to gain exposure to client conversations, needs discovery, and selling strategies

* Learn media planning fundamentals and the end\-to\-end advertising sales lifecycle
* Gain exposure to the systems, processes, and tools critical to future Account Executive success
  

**Basic Qualifications**


* 1\+ years of experience in digital advertising, media, or sales support (Digital Ad Sales, planning, buying, or agency experience preferred)
